summary: Elemental Royalty Corporation filed a Form 6-K on April 28, 2026, announcing the release of its Q1 2026 financial results on May 13, 2026, followed by an investor webcast on May 14, 2026. This is a routine earnings release and investor communication, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change is involved. The filing serves as a standard periodic report of a foreign private issuer.
